Package net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.example

Class PerformanceModel.NetworkDelegate

java.lang.Object
net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.example.PerformanceModel.NetworkDelegate
Enclosing class:
PerformanceModel
public class PerformanceModel.NetworkDelegate extends Object
A class to handle network connections over UDP, for example, with a Max or Pd patch. Used by applications that implement the PANetworkClientINF.
